generator: Local alpha matte (Pillow), no generative step
processing: Background pixels (max RGB channel <= 7) flood-filled from the frame edges; mask closed with 3px max/min filters; only the region connected to the subject kept (removes background specks); eroded 5px; Gaussian blur 1.2px. The approved photograph's RGB pixels are unchanged and the matte becomes the alpha channel. WebP quality 90. Fully transparent pixels carry the page ground colour #05060a in RGB, so encoder noise in the alpha channel stays invisible.
purpose: Courses page and course-area sign-in: the approved hero portrait standing on the lunar terrain without its near-black plate.
